name: Spellguard Shield
description: A shield whose face is a mirror of polished silver.
body:
## What it does

While you hold it, spells and magic find it hard to take hold of you, and spell attacks aimed at you go wide.

advantages.name: Saving throws
advantages.note: against spells and other magical effects

features.name: Spellguard
features.text: Spell attacks against you have disadvantage.
